result.stdout:
QueryDrift — Catch SQL Performance Regressions Before Production.

Usage:
  querydrift baseline create --input snapshots.json --output baseline.json --application <name> --release <version>
  querydrift compare --baseline baseline.json --current current.json [--threshold 2.0] [--min-increase-ms 25] [--min-samples 20] [--percentile p95] [--format text|json|markdown]
  querydrift report --input report.json [--format text|json|markdown]
  querydrift version

Exit codes: 0 no regression, 1 regression, 2 invalid input or execution error.
